Subject: Vendor registration failing + MSA redline (insurance)

Hi Kimberly,

We're trying to complete Lakewell's supplier registration in Ariba but the portal rejects the account when we upload your MSA. Our procurement system flagged two items that need alignment before we can finish the supplier record and push a PO:

- The insurance section in your MSA requests insurers to name Redwood as an additional insured; our legal team won't accept that as written and sent back a redline (attached).
- Our PO export requires a GL code field (project accounting) and a mandatory PO number field populated as a 10-digit string. The RedBud (our ERP) mapping also needs an explicit EDI flag for automated invoicing.

Can your team confirm whether you can accept the attached redline or propose alternate wording? Also — if possible — please provide the Order Form field mapping Redwood expects so I can validate with our Ariba admin.

We're on a compressed procurement window and would like to get a test PO into your system by next week.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Sr. Procurement Manager

Thanks for the context. I reviewed Lakewell's redline and suggest the following path to keep onboarding moving while protecting Redwood: 

1) Insurance: propose alternate clause language that narrows the "additional insured" requirement to third-party bodily injury and property damage only, and excludes cyber/privacy-related claims. I attached a tracked redline (Redwood_MSA_response_redline.docx).

2) Electronic signature / Order Form: accept DocuSign/electronic signature for Order Forms and confirm that the Order Form governs fee/po fields. We'll require the Order Form to include the GL_Code field as "optional" from Redwood's perspective but recommend Lakewell mark it mandatory on their side to satisfy ERP needs. This avoids contract-level obligations about customer accounting taxonomy.

3) Escalation: if Lakewell insists on being listed as certificate holder / additional insured for cyber coverage, we will need to route that to Exec Legal and Commercial for tradeoffs (this will likely add 5–7 business days).

I've added tracked changes and sample proposed language in the attached. If Marissa/Kimberly want to send the provisional acceptance, include a clear note: "Onboarding acceptance pending final legal sign-off — this acceptance is limited to the language attached and for the purposes of supplier setup and test POs only."

Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
